## Privacy checklist

- [ ] It doesn't record anything new, keep data longer, or weaken a skip rule, unless that's the point of the PR and it's explained above.
- [ ] It doesn't add a network connection. If it does, it's opt-in and the README's "Network connections" section is updated.
- [ ] The README, PRIVACY.md, docs/faq.md and SECURITY.md still describe what DayDream records and sends accurately (`python3 scripts/docs-claims-checks.py`).
- [ ] No real captured history, window titles, typed text, personal paths or screenshots of a real timeline appear in code, tests, fixtures, docs pictures or this PR.

## Sign-off

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) under the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
